name: android-skills
description: Android skills 是 Google 官方维护的、面向 AI 优化的模块化指令与资源仓库，帮助 LLM 更好地理解并执行符合 Android 开发最佳实践与官方指南的特定模式。Android skills 遵循开放标准的 agent skills 规范——用 markdown 文件（SKILL.md）给出任务的技术规格，并为 LLM 提供专业领域与工作流知识。

interface.shortDescription: AI-optimized Android development skills from Google.
interface.longDescription: Android skills are Google's official dedicated repository of AI-optimized, modular instructions and resources, to help LLMs better understand and execute specific patterns that follow the best practices and guidance on Android development. Android skills follow the open-standard agent skills - markdown files (SKILL.md) that provide a technical specification of a task, and ground LLMs with information on specialized domains and workflows.
